Priya (eng-platform): Quick sync — we need a single spec for new GPU metrics (SM occupancy, per-GPU mem, queue_depth) that works for Hosted + Dedicated. TL;DR: low-cardinality aggregate metrics + optional per-instance samples for debug. Need owners + UX for console. Who can drive?
Mateo (eng-runtime): I can draft metric names and sampling cadence. For SM occupancy we can sample kernel_time/active_warps and expose as `gpu.sm_occupancy_pct`.
Jing (eng-infra): Reminder: Dedicated customers cannot have per-host identifiers in hosted telemetry. Use pool_id and hashed instance_id when strictly necessary. Aggregates only by pool for hosted rollups.
Sam (eng-sre): For alerting we need 1m windows for queue_depth p50/p95 and memory_pressure spikes. Also want derived headroom metric for routing decisions.
Noor (product): Console UX ask: customers want slot-level view + a timeline overlay for rollouts/canaries. Default should be pool-level to avoid noise.
Casey (eng-console): UX ideas: toggle between `pool-aggregate` and `sampled-instances`, add rollout event overlay, and quantile selector (p50/p90/p99). Keep default lean.
Priya (eng-platform): Proposed canonical metric set and labels: 
```
- gpu.sm_occupancy_pct {pool_id, region, model_variant, deployment_mode}
- gpu.mem_used_mb {pool_id, region, deployment_mode}
- gpu.mem_total_mb {pool_id}
- gpu.queue_depth {pool_id, model_variant}
- gpu.eviction_count {pool_id}
```
Quantiles: p50,p90,p99. Windows: 1m, 5m, 1h. Thoughts?
Mateo (eng-runtime): +1 to names. Sampling: sm_occupancy every 10s, mem every 5s, queue_depth on event + 10s heartbeat. Aggregation: sum(queue_depth) per pool; mem_used -> avg across active slots; keep raw per-gpu only in a sampled debug stream.
Jing (eng-infra): Telemetry payload constraints: batch metrics, cap labels to (pool_id, region, deployment_mode, model_variant). No host_ip, no customer_pii. Use hashed instance_id for dedicated if owners need it. I'll add privacy rules.
Sam (eng-sre): Suggest derived metric: `gpu.headroom_slots` = floor(free_mem_mb / per_slot_mem_estimate). Expose as int per pool to drive routing & quota decisions. Also add `gpu.memory_pressure_rate` (delta mem_used / sec).
Noor (product): Routing/quotas: product wants `gpu.headroom_slots` available via internal routing API so router can pick pools without causing OOMs during canaries. Also need a flag to opt into aggressive packing for dedicated customers.
Casey (eng-console): For dashboarding: default tile = pool summary (sm occupancy p90, headroom_slots, queue_depth p95). Drilldowns show sampled instances with last-10s traces. Add a small legend for deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated).
Priya (eng-platform): Action items: Mateo -> PR with exporter shim + metric names by EOD Wed; Jing -> spec telemetry privacy + hashing; Casey -> console tile mockup + UX copy; Sam -> draft alert thresholds and derived metrics; Noor -> product acceptance criteria. Owners ok?
Mateo (eng-runtime): I'm on it, will link PR when ready. draft branch at https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/345 (WIP) :thumbsup:
Jing (eng-infra): I'll drop the hashing and privacy doc under infra/docs/telemetry by Friday and tag @security for review.
Casey (eng-console): I'll prototype the dashboard tile and post to the product board, will include a compact vs expanded layout.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll put a first-pass alert playbook and thresholds in the `oncall` repo.
deploy-bot: New canary deploy started for `runtime-metrics-exporter` by @Mateo at commit abc123
Priya (eng-platform): Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene next Tue to review PR + mockups.
